commits.title: feat(AI-dev): two-step GLM high thinking with qwen-coder subagent
commits.description:
- pi harness now runs GLM-4.7-Flash at high thinking in both phases
- plan phase writes precise, self-contained plans for a dumb executor
- build phase orchestrates: delegates guided details to the coder subagent (qwen3.8, low thinking) and verifies the results
- updated spec and tests for the new harness command

commits.title: fix(devlog): updated calendar button colors for better readability

- intensity-2: vibrant orange #ff8c2a background with dark text
- intensity-3: green #26a641 background with dark text
- intensity-4: bright green #57c46b background with dark text

Uses dark text (#0c0a08) on all color backgrounds for excellent readability following the dungeon theme palette.
